paper.title_en: Towards Dynamical Casimir sourced N00N states for quantum sensing
paper.abstract_en: We explore the uncorrelated photon saturation of N00N state based phase measurements. In the case of a single mode, any combination of coherent and squeezed vacuum states exhibits stringent upper limits to the entangled photon flux [1], beyond which sub shot noise precision is inaccessible. These upper limits prevent single mode N00N state phase measurement approaches from reaching the performance of their classical counterparts. Turning to multimode squeezed states, in particular sourced by the dynamical Casimir effect (DCE) in a THz modulation approach proposed in [2], we characterize the resulting improved ranges of permissible photon fluxes.
